en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Hassan, from Muhamad Bin Ali, from Abu Jameela, from Al Halby and Zurara as well, and Muhammad Bin Muslim and Humran Bin Ayn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
both having said: ‘The habitual (drinker of) the wine is like an idol worshipper’.
en.sarwar: 7. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn Hassan from Muhammad ibn Ali from abu Jamilah from al-Halabiy and Zurarah also and Muhammad ibn Muslim and Humran ibn ’A‘yan who have said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, and abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, have said, ‘
A wine addict is like an idol worshipper.’”
